definitions.definition: To move, or appear to move, physically upwards relative to the ground.
To increase in value or standing.
To go up; to ascend; to climb.
To cause to go up or ascend.
definitions.example: to rise a fish, or cause it to come to the surface of the water

definitions.definition: To retire; to give up a siege.
To be lifted, or capable of being lifted, from the imposing stone without dropping any of the type; said of a form.
The act of something that rises.
definitions.example: the risings and fallings of a thermometer

definitions.definition: A dough and yeast mixture which is allowed to ferment.
Planned or destined to advance to an academic grade in the near future, after having completed the previous grade; soon-to-be.

definitions.example: a horse rising six years of age
